programme.title: Romesh Ranganathan's Parents' Evening Christmas Special
programme.desc: Festive edition of the comedy game show in which celebrities team up with family members, with the parents choosing which questions their grown-up children will answer and gambling on how many they can get right. Featuring Larry Lamb and his son George, Motsi Mabuse and her mum Dudu, and Josh Widdicombe and his dad Tom competing for charity while, as ever, Romesh's mum Shanthi keeps score and brings extra festive banter

programme.title: Unwind with STV
programme.desc: Daily escape designed to calm the mind and encourage relaxation and reflection

programme.title: Ainsley's Festive Flavours
programme.desc: Ainsley Harriott throws open the kitchen doors and welcomes friends old and new for a Christmas feast. Actress and comedian Donna Preston pops in for a slice of mouth-watering tamarind, allspice and ginger glazed ham, with a juicy side of pineapple and rum relish, while actor Christopher Biggins joins for a taste of Ainsley's showstopping snow dome dessert, packed with festive flavours. Chef Phil Vickery lends a hand and offers up a party-friendly taste of the sea with his squid, prawn almond patties, and wine expert Jilly Goolden selects drinks for every occasion. Plus, music from classical star Alexis Ffrench

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: The chef explores the Isle of Wight with fellow culinary expert Lenny Carr-Roberts. James sets up at The Hut Café, Colwell to cook a dish of prawns with tomatoes, mangalitza chorizo and pancetta

programme.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning at Christmas
programme.desc: James celebrates Christmas at his home in the Hampshire countryside by serving up a feast of festive food for Strictly Come Dancing star Shirley Ballas.

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: The Great British Bake Off judge returns to share more recipes, tips and handy culinary hacks . She is joined for the opening edition by actress Angela Griffin, who is treated to a Cambodian dish of fish and prawn amok. Prue also makes meat and vegetarian lasagnes, while her husband John heads off to a local alpaca farm where he learns how they are taken care of and finds out what their wool is used for

programme.title: ITV News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
programme.desc: James cooks for Grantchester stars Rishi Nair and Kacey Ainsworth and wildlife filmmaker Gordon Buchanan, and there are recipes from chefs Cyrus Todiwala and Ronnie Murray

programme.title: Ainsley's Taste of the Bahamas
programme.desc: Chef Ainsley Harriott explores the vibrant flavours, local producers, markets and unique dishes of the island nation located in the Atlantic Ocean. He kicks off his island adventures with the comfort foods at the heart of Bahamian cooking, from 'chicken in da bag' at Bamboo Shack to learning to put his peas before his rice with chef Tevin Kemp. Then he wraps things up in his beachside kitchen with prawn and coconut fritters served with a pickled coconut slaw

programme.title: Simply Raymond Blanc
programme.desc: The chef shares his love of new produce from the gardens and explains why seasonality is important and why everyone should embrace it. From his Oxfordshire kitchen, he cooks pan-fried salmon with spinach and chive butter sauce, and rustles up a fricassee of wild mushrooms. Long-time friend Jean-Christophe Novelli pays a visit and bakes him an indulgent tarte tatin, and baked apple with caramel

programme.title: ITV News and Weather
programme.desc: Round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: STV Racing: Live from Sandown
programme.desc: Ed Chamberlin presents coverage of a meeting headlined by the Unibet Veterans' Chase from Sandown Park, plus racing from Wincanton. With analysis from Tom Scudamore, reports by Oli Bell and Alice Plunkett, and commentary from Richard Hoiles

programme.title: ITV News and Weather
programme.desc: Round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Ant and Dec's Limitless Win Christmas Special
programme.desc: Ant and Dec spread the Christmas joy by surprising two audience members with the chance to take on the money-making ladder - but for the first time, they will be playing alongside their own celebrity team-mates. Mother-of-two Brooke, who has recently had cancer and set up a support group for women in her local area, is joined by Amanda Holden to make as much money as she can. Army veteran Nigel, who has launched a coffee company to support the mental health of other ex-servicemen and women, will be accompanied by football star Jamie Redknapp. Will these famous faces help the players to a festive fortune?

programme.title: Celebrity Catchphrase
programme.desc: Stephen Mulhern hosts another charity edition of the game show, with Natalie Cassidy, Sam Aston and Lou Sanders trying to say what they see as they guess well-known phrases for the chance to win a £50,000 jackpot for their chosen good causes

programme.title: The Masked Singer
programme.desc: Joel Dommett is back with the singing contest in which celebrity panellists Jonathan Ross, Davina McCall, Mo Gilligan and Maya Jama must guess the identities of the famous faces performing behind elaborate costumes. The first six masked singers battling it out are Red Panda, Moth, Disc Jockey, Sloth, Gargoyle and Can of Worms, while Goldfish fronts the Masked Band

programme.title: Wheel of Fortune
programme.desc: Graham Norton hosts the game show as executive assistant Yemi, funeral celebrant Richard and support worker Aimee compete to solve word puzzles to get the chance to spin the wheel and win big money prizes, with a potential jackpot of £50,000

programme.title: The 1% Club
programme.desc: Quiz game show hosted by Lee Mack in which the questions have nothing to do with remembering facts, but are all about logic and common sense. A hundred contestants begin every show, but who will make it to the end and answer a question only one per cent of the country can get right - and win up to £100,000?

programme.title: The Hunting Wives
programme.desc: Margo attempts to win back Sophie with a surprise, while Jill's concern about her son's relationship with Abby intensifies, as does Callie's jealousy. The police make a chilling discovery in the case of the unidentified dead woman

programme.desc: Freddie Flintoff is joined by three pairs of contestants each made up of a keen darts player (the 'thrower') and their partner (the 'knower'). The teams compete against each other, combining their skills at throwing darts at different game boards while answering questions correctly for points and prizes under the watchful eye of official scorer Richard Ashdown. Freddie is also joined by former world champion Michael van Gerwen, as they combine to complete a charity challenge
